name: FNB Student Checking
forWho: High school, college, trade school, and graduate students. Applicants under 18 open jointly with a parent or guardian.
keyTerms: No monthly service charge or minimum balance
No overdraft fees; transactions are declined when funds are short
Refunds FNB's fee for non-FNB ATMs up to 4 times per statement cycle
One free incoming wire per statement cycle
Includes Credit Center, Zelle, CardGuard, and mobile deposit

name: FNB eStyle Checking
forWho: Anyone with a non-expired ID. Bank On certified, checkless account.
keyTerms: $25 to open online, $0 in a branch
Monthly fee waived with 1+ deposit or 5+ transactions per statement cycle
No overdraft fee; transactions are declined or returned
No paper checks; free Visa debit card, Zelle, and instant payments

name: FNB Freestyle Checking
forWho: Anyone with a non-expired ID.
keyTerms: $50 to open online, $0 in a branch
No monthly fee with free online statements
No minimum balance
Unlimited check writing and about 1,800 surcharge-free ATMs
Pairs with FirstRate Savings in one eStore application

name: FNB FirstRate Savings
forWho: Anyone with a non-expired ID. FNB's companion savings account to Student Checking.
keyTerms: $50 to open online, $0 in a branch
$5 monthly fee, waived with a $500 average daily balance
6 transfers or withdrawals a month; $15 for each one over
Branch and ATM transactions are unlimited
Tiered rate; interest compounds quarterly

name: FNB FirstRate Money Market
forWho: Anyone with a non-expired ID.
keyTerms: $50 to open online, $0 in a branch
$10 monthly fee, waived with a $5,000 average daily balance
6 transfers or withdrawals per statement cycle; $15 for each one over
Check writing allowed
Tiered, variable rate; interest paid monthly

name: FNB Savers Goal CD
forWho: Anyone with a non-expired ID saving toward a specific goal.
keyTerms: 12-month fixed term that renews automatically
$100 minimum to open
At least $25 a month in transfers from an FNB checking or savings account
Add deposits any time
Early withdrawal penalty applies

name: FNB Certificate of Deposit Specials
forWho: Consumers in PA, OH, WV, NC, SC, VA, MD, and DC with new money and an FNB checking account.
keyTerms: Requires new money and an FNB checking account; one per household
Published minimums range from $2,500 to $10,000 depending on term; confirm with FNB
Early withdrawal penalties may apply
Renews at the base rate at maturity
rateNote: 3.00% APY (5-month), 3.75% APY (7-month), 4.15% APY (13-month), as of Oct 1, 2026

name: FNB SmartSecured Credit Card
forWho: People building or rebuilding credit, including those turned down for credit in the past.
keyTerms: No annual fee
Credit limit equals your savings deposit, $500 to $2,000
Subject to credit approval

name: FNB SmartCash Credit Card
forWho: General consumers who want simple cash back.
keyTerms: No annual fee
2% cash back on qualified purchases, no cap
Redeem to FNB checking or for gift cards
Subject to credit approval

name: FNB SmartRewards Credit Card
forWho: General consumers who want points for travel and experiences.
keyTerms: No annual fee
1 point per $1, double points for the first 90 days
Redeem for travel, merchandise, experiences, or gift cards
Points expire after 5 years
Subject to credit approval

name: FNB SmartRate Credit Card
forWho: General consumers who want a low rate or a balance transfer.
keyTerms: No annual fee
0% intro APR for 12 months
Then a variable APR based on creditworthiness
Subject to credit approval
rateNote: 0% intro APR for 12 months, then 15.74% to 23.74% variable APR

name: FNB Home Ownership Program
forWho: Low- to moderate-income buyers, or buyers in low- to moderate-income communities. Less-than-perfect credit is considered.
keyTerms: Little to no down payment required
Up to $5,000 closing cost grant from FNB
No mortgage insurance required
Closing funds can come from a gift or grant
Subject to underwriting

name: HomeOne Mortgage (Freddie Mac)
forWho: Qualified first-time homebuyers. No income or geographic restrictions.
keyTerms: 3% minimum down payment
Fixed rate
Homebuyer education required
Single-family homes, townhouses, and condos
Subject to underwriting

name: FHA Mortgage
forWho: First-time and experienced buyers. Less-than-perfect credit is considered.
keyTerms: Low down payment
Fixed rate
Mortgage insurance required on all FHA loans
Subject to underwriting

name: Home Possible Mortgage (Freddie Mac)
forWho: Low- to moderate-income borrowers; first-time buyer status not required.
keyTerms: Low down payment
Cancellable mortgage insurance
Homebuyer education required if all borrowers are first-time buyers
Subject to underwriting

name: FNB Free Small Business Checking
forWho: Businesses. Open with an ID, SSN and/or EIN, and formation documents depending on business type.
keyTerms: $50 to open online, $0 in a branch
No monthly fee
150 free transactions and $4,999.99 in cash deposits a month
$200 Merchant Services credit

name: FNB SBA Lending (7(a), 504, Express)
forWho: Small businesses funding startup costs, working capital, equipment, or real estate.
keyTerms: SBA Express up to $350,000, usually a 5- or 7-year term
SBA 504: up to 90% financing for existing businesses
"Better Together" pairs an SBA 7(a) loan with Free Small Business Checking
Subject to credit approval

name: FNB Learning Center
forWho: Anyone. Free self-paced money lessons, plus free EVERFI modules for college students.
keyTerms: Free self-paced modules
Modules: Creating a Budget, Credit Scores & Reports, Credit Cards, Buying a Home, and more
Free college modules through EVERFI

name: FNB Credit Center
forWho: FNB banking customers; included with Student Checking.
keyTerms: Free VantageScore 3.0 from TransUnion, updated monthly
Full report, monitoring alerts, tips, and disputes
Soft inquiry; checking does not affect your score

name: Student Loans (partner programs)
forWho: Students through Sallie Mae Smart Option (undergraduates) and PHEAA's PA Forward and Keystone programs.
keyTerms: Offered through partner programs: Sallie Mae, PA Forward, Keystone
Eligibility depends on the program and your school's location
Amounts and terms set by each program
